title: Grouping notes
summary: Beam quavers and semiquavers so every beat is easy to see.
usSummary: Beam eighth notes and sixteenth notes so every beat is easy to see.

hook.text: Read this: thecatsatonthemat. Now this: the cat sat on the mat. Same letters, but the spaces make the second one quick to read. Music has its own spaces. Press play and watch the quick notes. Can you see each beat?

explore.text: Your turn. Count 1, 2, 3, 4 and tap every note. Look at the beams as you go: each beamed group starts on a beat. Use the groups to find your place.
explore.goal: Tap every note in all 4 [[bar|bars]], using the beamed groups to find each beat.

cards.text: Beams show where the beats are. [[quaver|Quavers]] are usually joined in pairs, one pair to a beat. [[semiquaver|Semiquavers]] are joined in fours, one group to a beat. A note on its own keeps its hook.

In 4/4 you may join four [[quaver|quavers]] across beats 1 and 2, or across beats 3 and 4, but never across the middle of the [[bar|bar]]. In 2/4 or 3/4 a whole [[bar|bar]] of [[quaver|quavers]] may be one group.

Keep the middle of a 4/4 [[bar|bar]] in view. A note that would hide it is split into two tied notes. A silent half is one [[minim-rest|minim rest]]. Silent beats 2 and 3 are two [[crotchet-rest|crotchet rests]].

alternative.text: Try the clap test. Clap the beat and look at the beams: every beamed group should start on a clap. If you can find each beat by spotting where a group starts, the [[bar|bar]] is grouped well. Try it on the [[bar|bar]] below: four claps.

points: Beams show where the beats are. [[quaver|Quavers]] are usually joined in pairs and [[semiquaver|semiquavers]] in fours, one group to a beat.

In 4/4 a beam of four [[quaver|quavers]] may cover beats 1 and 2, or beats 3 and 4, but never crosses the middle of the [[bar|bar]]. In 2/4 or 3/4 a whole [[bar|bar]] of [[quaver|quavers]] may share one beam.
Keep the middle of a 4/4 [[bar|bar]] in view: use a tie, not a note across it; one [[minim-rest|minim rest]] for a silent half; two [[crotchet-rest|crotchet rests]] for silent beats 2 and 3.
